title: May 5, 2026: Top 5 AI News For Today!
description:
AI is moving fast—and today’s top 5 stories prove it.

From OpenAI’s unexpected $5B connection to Y Combinator, to massive enterprise AI investments from OpenAI and Anthropic, the focus is clearly shifting toward business use. At the same time, new tools like Anthropic’s upcoming “Orbit” assistant show where productivity is headed—AI that actually works with your daily tools.

But it’s not all upside. GPT-5.5 pricing is rising, and advanced AI is getting more expensive to use. And looking ahead, researchers say there’s a real chance AI could start improving itself by 2028… which could change everything.

This is your quick, no-fluff breakdown of the most important AI news today.
